title: Running Config vs Startup Config
description: Understand the difference between running-config and startup-config and how to manage both.
scenario: Understand the difference between running-config and startup-config and how to manage both.

concepts.title: Running Config
concepts.body: The running-config is the active configuration stored in RAM. Changes take effect immediately.
concepts.code:
SW1# show running-config
! Active configuration — lives in RAM

concepts.title: Startup Config
concepts.body: The startup-config is stored in NVRAM. It loads into RAM when the switch boots.
concepts.code:
SW1# show startup-config
! Boot configuration — lives in NVRAM

concepts.title: Saving & Restoring
concepts.body: Use "write memory" or "copy running-config startup-config" to save. Use "copy startup-config running-config" to restore.
concepts.code:
Save:   write memory
Restore: copy startup-config running-config
